timing_scope: Single observation; not a latency promise. Tutorial is edited and not used as timing evidence.

video.treatment: Edited original-speed clips, labelled screenshots, editorial cards, full actual inference wait retained.
video.captions: Optional external WebVTT; off by default, no burned-in dialogue captions.

narration.local_asr_check: All ten scenes match the script after punctuation/case normalization and documented proper-name spelling equivalents. Human full-listening review not performed.
narration.generation: One connected paragraph and one inference per scene; shared gain.
narration.caption_timing: Native ONNX duration output, mapped via Misaki word/phoneme spans; adjusted for model edge trim. Not uniform word allocation or ASR forced alignment.
narration.caption_timing_limits: Native word spans use 25ms model duration frames and may include trailing acoustic silence. Phrase/caption/sync edges are bounded by actual >=150ms pauses measured in 10ms RMS windows at -50dBFS. These are objective estimates, not human-verified exact word onsets; raw native spans and ASR timestamps are retained.
